title: Brik à l'Oeuf
description: Brik à l'Oeuf is a Tunisia classic prepared with canned tuna, parsley, capers, phyllo pastry. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Thin phyllo sheets replace traditional Tunisian malsouka/brik pastry. Eggs are cooked until firm for food safety.

steps.instruction: Prepare the filling ingredients: cook or soften any components that require it, let cool, then mix into an even filling.
Use two thin phyllo sheets per brik; spread the tuna-herb filling and add one egg per parcel, folding into a triangle with sealed edges.
Fry each brik until crisp and the enclosed egg is fully cooked, adjusting heat to avoid burning the delicate pastry.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
